remaining_useful_life.instruction: Estimate the remaining useful life of this simulated turbofan engine at the end of the observed history. Predict the number of operating cycles remaining until failure; the target is not capped.
remaining_useful_life.field_description: history_columns defines each of the 30 chronological history rows: cycle (operating cycles), three operational settings, and sensor_1 through sensor_21. Sensor and setting values retain original published scales; individual physical units are unspecified in the source readme. subset identifies the published operating-condition/fault scenario. No engine ID is an input feature.
